content.short: Cleopatra is a concentrated liquidity DEX on Mantle using ve(3,3) tokenomics to align long-term incentives for traders and liquidity providers.
content.description: Cleopatra Exchange is a decentralized exchange on Mantle featuring concentrated liquidity pools combined with a ve(3,3) governance and incentive model that rewards long-term token holders and liquidity providers. The ve(3,3) mechanism merges vote-escrowed token locking with Olympus-style rebase mechanics, creating strong incentives for protocol participation. Concentrated liquidity allows LPs to focus capital within specific price ranges for dramatically improved fee income compared to traditional AMMs.
